command: Anopheles gambiae TOLL9 (Q5TWL7/AGAP006974) has pattern-recognition receptor activity and participates in innate immunity through the Toll signaling pathway. Assess actual target phylogeny and transfer scope, ligand and accessory/downstream partners. Current target leaf PTN000688561 in PTHR24365 descends from PTN002808045 supporting generic receptor/signaling/plasma membrane. PMID33963082 establishes Bombyx Toll9 LPS recognition with MD-2-like partners, including a chimera whose TM/TIR regions are mouse TLR4; distinguish those experiments. PMID21386906 reports Drosophila Toll9 knockout without basal or inducible antibacterial AMP defects under tested conditions, while acknowledging overexpression-induced signaling. PMID38191283 reports AGAP006974 induction after mosGILT disruption, not target perturbation. Determine whether conservation supports PRR/Toll immune roles or target divergence changes them; a small experimental donor set alone is not weak evidence. Do not assume every insect Toll uses Spaetzle, or confuse recognition of processed host cytokine with GO0038187 microbial PAMP recognition. The separate inflammatory-response row is already resolved by explicit GO0006954 vertebrate-only constraint and is not this question.
